text: The authors derive that as Delta_domain goes to minus infinity (very hard games for Houdini) n* tends to Delta_general times log(10)/400, explaining the equally spaced vertical lines in Fig. 7; as Delta_domain goes to infinity (very hard games for the Guard) n* tends to 1; and on the line Delta_general = Delta_domain, n* = 1.
title: Asymptotics of the optimal number of NSO steps n*
